title: Resting ECG context for horizontal exercise ST slope: uncertain prediction and absent joint support across centers
abstract: ECG-category-2 by horizontal-ST-slope modeling did not establish incremental cross-center disease prediction: Brier difference -0.005296 (joint bootstrap95% [-0.022154, 0.014680]); no eligible Hungarian ECG-category-2 record had observed slope, preventing validation of the physiological joint pattern.
